how_to_use: Event write-ups the importer reads on every run even when they are no longer linked from a news list page (a series announced months ago, such as a multi-city tour). Add { "url": "https://pokemongo.com/news/...", "note": "why" }. Only pokemongo.com, leekduck.com and pokemongohub.net pages are read. Remove an entry once the event is over.
